Correctly parameterized with the sourced BASE_URL (8081) and DB config. This completes the pipeline for all 5 endpoints.

## Summary

Ran the full NIMBUS flat/template pipeline (Pre-Step → Step 1 → per-endpoint Step 2/2-B/3/4/5) directly, with no subagent delegation, for all 5 requested endpoints:

| Endpoint | Tests | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/auth/guest` | 3 NTC | No params/auth/DB fixtures possible (server-generated UUID PK) |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/login` | 3 NTC + 6 VTC + 3 ATC | RED params (`provider`,`providerToken`) hand-derived from source since the static analyzer misses interface-dispatch branches |
| `POST /internal/auth/verify` | 3 NTC + 3 VTC + 1 ATC | "Active token" branch undocumentable (Redis-backed, no chaining path into JSON body) |
| `GET /internal/users/{id}` | 3 NTC + 3 ATC | Fully deterministic via DB fixtures (no Redis dependency) |
| `GET /api/v1/me` | 3 NTC | Used `bearer-token` auth catalog (guest login chain) to get real tokens; documented why auth-failure ATCs can't coexist in the same class |

All specs used structured fixtures/auth catalog (`template-usage.json`: 0 raw SQL, 0 custom auth, 0 raw stubs). No WireMock stubs were needed anywhere — `social.*.mode` defaults to `mock` so all social login goes through the deterministic `MockSocialVerifier`, confirmed by `detect-external-calls` reporting zero external calls.

Every spec's `docLines` documents the judgment calls made where tooling heuristics were wrong or limited (false-positive `ATC_code400` suggestions, renderer's lack of boolean/null-safe assertions, the Redis-chaining gap, single-auth-pattern-per-class trade-off). `manifest.json` has all 5 endpoints with `status: ok`. Per scope, no `mvn`/docker/test execution was performed.
